name: fixer
prompt: The fixer: a wiry man in his late fifties who repairs old radios in a cramped back-street shop and secretly installs illegal biohacks. Hollow cheeks, grey stubble, tired and watchful eyes, a thin scar at his right temple. Like everyone, he wears a partial helmet: a cheap, scratched visor of plastic and metal bolted over his left eye and temple. A pilled grey cardigan over a stained work shirt with rolled sleeves, burn marks on his hands, worn trousers, scuffed boots. Standing slightly hunched, a soldering iron in one hand.
concierge: The Concierge's flattering version of the same man: groomed and handsome for his age, neat silver hair and a trimmed beard, a tailored charcoal knit, dark trousers, polished boots, and the visor sleek and glossy with a faint cyan light. Same pose, same soldering iron.
